settings.refresh_interval.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
settings.refresh_interval.description: How often to rescan sysfs and the embedded controller.
settings.query_ec.label: Query the Chrome/Framework EC
settings.query_ec.description: Read per-port voltage, current and power over /dev/cros_ec. Needs read access to that device; see the plugin README.
settings.show_advanced.label: Show Thunderbolt / USB4 devices
settings.show_advanced.description: Add a panel section for the Thunderbolt and USB4 buses and, where readable, the USB debugfs dump.
settings.show_usb_devices.label: Show USB devices
settings.show_usb_devices.description: Add a panel section listing every device on /sys/bus/usb/devices.
settings.show_root_hubs.label: Include USB root hubs
settings.show_root_hubs.description: Keep the host controllers in the USB device list instead of hiding them.
settings.glyph.label: Bar icon
settings.display.label: Bar text
settings.display.description: What to show next to the icon.
panel.empty-detail: The kernel is not publishing any Type-C ports or Power Delivery capabilities. That is normal when firmware negotiates PD without handing identity data to the kernel; what is available then comes from the embedded controller.
panel.permission-hint: Grant read access to /dev/cros_ec to see per-port power: sudo setfacl -m "u:$USER:r" /dev/cros_ec (see the plugin README for a persistent udev rule).
